TRUNCATE TABLE stg.csi_Vendor;

WITH ADDR AS (
    SELECT 
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY site_ref, vend_num ORDER BY VariationNumber DESC) AS rn,
        vend_num,
        Name,
        CAST(RecordDate AS DATE) AS RecordDate,
        site_ref,
        country
    FROM raw.csi_vendaddr_mst
),
VEND AS (
    SELECT 
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY site_ref, vend_num ORDER BY RecordDate DESC) AS rn,
        vend_num,
        vend_type,
        stat,
        site_ref
    FROM raw.csi_vendor_mst
)

INSERT INTO stg.csi_Vendor (
    vend_num,
    vend_name,
    country,
    vend_type,
    stat,
    site_ref
)
SELECT 
    ADDR.vend_num,
    ADDR.Name,
    ADDR.country,
    VEND.vend_type,
    VEND.stat,
    ADDR.site_ref
FROM ADDR
INNER JOIN VEND 
    ON ADDR.site_ref = VEND.site_ref 
    AND ADDR.vend_num = VEND.vend_num
WHERE ADDR.rn = 1 AND VEND.rn = 1;

delete from temp_DimCustomer;

insert into temp_DimCustomer
(
	CustomerNumber
	,CustomerName
	,Country
	,CountryCode
	,CustomerType
	,CustomerStatus
	,SFCustomerType
	,Site
	,cus_h_key
)
SELECT 
	cust_num
	,name
	,country
	,'CA'
	,cust_type
	,stat
	,uf_sf_customer_type
	,site_ref
	,HASHBYTES('SHA1', concat(cust_num,cust_type,site_ref)) cus_h_key
FROM stg.csi_Customer;

merge edw.Dim_Customer as tgt
	using (select CustomerNumber, CustomerName, Country, CountryCode, CustomerType, CustomerStatus, SFCustomerType, Site from temp_DimCustomer) as src
	on (tgt.CustomerNumber = src.CustomerNumber and
		tgt.Site = src.Site)
when matched then
	update
		set CustomerName = tgt.CustomerName
when not matched then
	insert (CustomerNumber, CustomerName, Country, CountryCode, CustomerType, CustomerStatus, SFCustomerType, Site)
	values (src.CustomerNumber, src.CustomerName, src.Country, src.CountryCode, src.CustomerType, src.CustomerStatus, src.SFCustomerType, src.Site);
